messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 18):
"""
4.9 Waiting Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits Name of Cover or Plan or Option Waiting Period (in Days) 4.10 Survival Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits Name of Cover or Plan or Option Survival Period (in Days) S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 4.11 Exclusions: please specify the permanent exclusions proposed for payment of benefits 4.12 Time-bound Exclusions proposed for payment of benefits Section V - Other Terms 5.1 Procedure for Renewal 5.2 Conditions for reinstatement/revival of the contract, in case of instalment premiums:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What waiting period is proposed for payment of benefits under a health insurance plan?","answer":"The waiting period for payment of benefits is specified in the table under 'Waiting Period (in Days)' for each cover or plan.","facts":["Waiting Period (in Days)","Name of Cover or Plan or Option","4.9 Waiting Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits"]},{"question":"Where can the survival period for payment of benefits be found in the IRDAI master circular?","answer":"The survival period is listed under 'Survival Period (in Days)' in the same table that lists waiting periods.","facts":["Survival Period (in Days)","Name of Cover or Plan or Option","4.10 Survival Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits"]}]}
